si.name: Silicio (diamante)
si.fdfText:
SystemLabel si
XC.functional LDA
XC.authors CA
DM.Tolerance 1.e-6
SaveRho true
SaveDeltaRho true
WriteMullikenPop 1
WriteHirshfeldPop true
WriteVoronoiPop true
SolutionMethod diagon
NumberOfSpecies 1
NumberOfAtoms 2
%block ChemicalSpeciesLabel
 1 14 Si
%endblock ChemicalSpeciesLabel
PAO.BasisSize DZP
LatticeConstant 1.0 Ang
%block LatticeVectors
0.0 2.7155 2.7155
2.7155 0.0 2.7155
2.7155 2.7155 0.0
%endblock LatticeVectors
AtomicCoordinatesFormat Fractional
%block AtomicCoordinatesAndAtomicSpecies
0.0 0.0 0.0 1
0.25 0.25 0.25 1
%endblock AtomicCoordinatesAndAtomicSpecies
MeshCutoff 300 Ry
%block kgrid_Monkhorst_Pack
 8 0 0 0.5
 0 8 0 0.5
 0 0 8 0.5
%endblock kgrid_Monkhorst_Pack

plane.desc: plano (1̄10) que contiene los enlaces Si–Si
